content.value_statement: Block theme work can fail when theme.json, templates, and Site Editor overrides interact. This skill guides safe edits, focused troubleshooting, and verification.
actual_capabilities: Locates block theme roots by checking theme.json, templates, and parts.
Guides changes to global settings, global styles, and per-block styles.
Explains templates, template parts, patterns, and style variations.
Troubleshoots Site Editor, frontend, and editor style mismatches.
Points to focused reference notes for common block theme workflows.
limitations: Requires a WordPress repository and a target theme directory.
Some workflows need WP-CLI or a running WordPress environment.
Cannot inspect user customizations stored in the database without site access.
Does not replace official WordPress compatibility testing.

use_cases.title: Update Theme Defaults
use_cases.description: Change colors, typography, spacing, and block styles while respecting WordPress theme.json behavior.

use_cases.title: Audit Theme Structure
use_cases.description: Confirm templates, parts, patterns, and style variations are in valid block theme locations.

use_cases.title: Debug Editor Differences
use_cases.description: Trace why frontend, post editor, and Site Editor styles do not match expected theme defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Block Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery in an unfamiliar repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this WordPress repository and identify block theme roots. Report the likely target theme and any missing inputs before changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Adjust Theme Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Routine theme.json settings and styles update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the target block theme to support the requested colors, typography, and spacing. Explain which theme.json settings and styles changed.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Style Mismatches
prompt_templates.prompt: Find why the requested theme styles do not appear in the editor or frontend. Check theme root, overrides, schema shape, and cache effects.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Theme Conversion
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration from a classic theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a classic-to-block-theme conversion. Identify required templates, parts, patterns, style variations, compatibility risks, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: User asks: Find the active block theme and summarize its structure.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the likely theme root, notes theme.json, templates, parts, patterns, and style variations, then lists missing context.

output_examples.input: User asks: Explain why color changes do not appear in the Site Editor.
output_examples.output: The response checks active theme selection, user customizations, theme.json validity, and editor refresh behavior before recommending changes.

output_examples.input: User asks: Add a new style variation to an existing block theme.
output_examples.output: The response proposes a variation name, expected settings, affected files, and verification steps for Site Editor and frontend views.

best_practices: Confirm the target theme root before editing theme files.
Check user customizations before assuming theme.json changes failed.
Verify changes in the Site Editor, post editor, and frontend.
anti_patterns: Editing an inactive theme and expecting the site to change.
Putting template parts inside nested folders.
Changing style variations without checking stored user selections.

faq.question: What WordPress work does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers block theme structure, theme.json, templates, parts, patterns, style variations, and style troubleshooting.

faq.question: Can it create a new block theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides theme scaffolding and recommends starting from a known good structure or export.

faq.question: Does it require WP-CLI?
faq.answer: Not always. Some verification and site-state checks may need WP-CLI or a running WordPress environment.

faq.question: Can it fix Site Editor overrides?
faq.answer: It can identify likely overrides and explain checks. It needs site access to inspect stored user customizations.

faq.question: Does it support classic themes?
faq.answer: It is focused on block themes. It can help plan conversion from a classic theme.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
